purpose: Teach: 敬愛/則っ/基い/準じ/使途/呼び掛け/打ち込み/ベルク

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、創業仲間を敬愛された
lines.en: Father respected his founding partners deeply.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Voice carries quiet weight—not lecturing, remembering. Gentle emphasis on the word 'respected' as if it still matters now. Patient, almost musical pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社則に則って経営された
lines.en: Yes. Father managed the company according to its principles.
lines.style: Steady, formal register. Clear enunciation on 'principles'—not rigid, but grounded. Slight pause before speaking, as if considering which memory to honor. Voice holds both admiration and quiet understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、データに基いた経営判断をされた
lines.en: Father made his business decisions based on data, not intuition.
lines.style: Softer than before. Eyes-closed quality to the voice—not wistful exactly, but reaching back. Slight lift on 'data' as if still surprised by his father's foresight. Trailing breath at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界慣行に準じて契約された
lines.en: Yes. Father honored industry standards in every contract he made.
lines.style: Measured, almost ceremonial. Each phrase given its own small weight. Voice doesn't rush—this is respect in the form of careful speech. Quiet pride underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、寄付の使途を明確にされた
lines.en: Father was always clear about where donations went.
lines.style: Softer still, almost confessional. The word 'clear' receives gentle emphasis—as if transparency was rare enough to remark on. Voice trails slightly, inviting reflection rather than agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員への呼び掛けを大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father believed deeply in speaking directly with his staff.
lines.style: Grounded, present tense entering the voice. Less formal now—moving from recitation into genuine conviction. Solid on 'directly'—this mattered to him, and it matters still.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、事業に打ち込み続けられた
lines.en: Father never stopped throwing himself into the work.
lines.style: Smaller breath before starting. Voice has longing in it now—not sadness, but the weight of continuity. 'Never stopped' carries a slight tremor of understanding. Open, unguarded ending.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんがドイツベルクの取引先と縁を作られた
lines.en: Yes. Father built a lasting partnership with the Delberg firm—one that still holds.
lines.style: Closing breath. Warm, conclusive but not final. Light emphasis on 'built'—suggesting both work and care. Voice settles like a door closing gently. The final sentence lands with quiet completion.
